added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: the scenario gate computes and records the centroid and residual tolerances but never asserts them, so a centroid past one grid cell or a residual past the stated tolerance still exits 0 and the done-when cannot fail.

follow-on: the filament branch re-implements the per-section sub-gridding and current_share weighting that nova/circuit/linkage.py:81 section_grid already owns (it duplicates that owner rather than extending it), so a change to the linkage sub-grid rule leaves the two out of step.
follow-on: assert_array_equal(history[0], history[1]) compares two invocations given identical inputs, so it fails only on nondeterminism and is not a guard for any behaviour.
follow-on: Profile.prescribed_current (profiles.py:234) has no caller; the tests and scripts/iter_prescribed_plasma/measure.py:86 call the free function, so the added public method is unreached.

item_verdicts.diff: read the ten commits 8f294d56..ab99b4850 commit by commit; the code change is nova/imas/profiles.py (+163/-3) and the new nova/imas/prescribed_plasma.py, plus tests, the measure.py driver and docs.
item_verdicts.done_when: nova/imas/profiles.py and scripts/iter_prescribed_plasma/measure.py:461 measure centroid vs DINA, the scale distribution, the linked-flux residual and the 1 cm vertical control, all recorded in scenario-verified.log.
item_verdicts.goal: nova/imas/profiles.py:94 prescribe_current_density and nova/imas/prescribed_plasma.py:14 plasma_flux_at_points build the closed-boundary DINA prescription and the generic conductor linkage the brief names.
item_verdicts.manifest: read manifest.md and landing.md; they report 867/867 prescribed slices, 4.14 mm maximum centroid error, 2.168%/0.427%/0.406% residuals, and name the gate logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares nova/imas/, tests/test_prescribed_plasma.py, scripts/iter_prescribed_plasma, docs/research, docs/figures and the evidence fragment; every path in the diff (git diff --stat = 9 files) is inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_prescribed_plasma.py:122 fails when the vertical offset is dropped (vertical-shift-mutation.log, EXIT=1), but no test guards the DINA-path thresholds and the focused arm ran at 6ea7fa6, not the reviewed head.
justifications.evidence: scripts/iter_prescribed_plasma/measure.py:461 records the done-when measures in summary.json and scenario-verified.log, but the gate asserts only the vertical control (measure.py:353), not the centroid or residual thresholds.
justifications.fit: names in nova/imas/prescribed_plasma.py and nova/imas/profiles.py:28 are capability-named with no plan or version labels and follow the surrounding module style.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/imas/prescribed_plasma.py:14 and nova/imas/profiles.py:94 implement the boundary mask, current scaling and filament/section linkage the brief requires.
justifications.reuse: nova/imas/prescribed_plasma.py:95 reuses section_points and greens_psi but re-derives the section sub-gridding and current_share weighting owned by nova/circuit/linkage.py:section_grid.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches only the declared write paths, and no file outside the brief's scope (nova/imas/, tests, scripts, docs) is changed.
